answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Every claim climbs the nebula of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the bridge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the wander of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
